introHtml: Gray nursing scrubs offer a professional, neutral look that hides stains better than lighter colors while remaining softer on the eyes than black. They are a popular choice for hospitals and clinics that want a modern, uniform appearance. Custom embroidery with your facility’s logo or staff names is available in contrasting thread colors for easy identification.
